supersedes.why: km delivered the 2018-10-23 multi-Rf scenario grids with same-report B0 evidence. That clears the book-basis question the v2/v3 gates were written for and moves the open question to the (b,c) ridge. v4 records what cleared, what did not, and freezes the next discriminator before its evidence is sought.

what_km_delivered_and_the_handler_verifi.artifact: _tmp/yoo-e2/panel_grids.json key yoo_201810_index_scenarios, 6 grids, source sha256 pinned
what_km_delivered_and_the_handler_verifi.design: same index, same date, same B0, with Rf and RP both moving between a normal leg (Rf 3.5%, RP 5.0%) and a worst leg (Rf 4.0%, RP 6.0%). This separates the discount rate from the hurdle, which no single-date grid can do.
what_km_delivered_and_the_handler_verifi.b0_provenance: printed in the same report at p.35, as-of 2018-10-12: Dow 25,052/3.06 = 8,186.9; SPX 2,728/2.70 = 1,010.4; Nasdaq 7,329/3.74 = 1,959.6. The same table's 2018E/2019E/2020E ROE columns reproduce the grids' 3-year-mean centres (23.53->23.5, 18.93->18.9, 21.77->21.7), which links the table to the grids by more than coincidence.

handler_independent_rerun.note: km reported 1072.6/874.7/951.9 for the global case and the handler gets 1164.6/876.1/949.9; the small gaps are search-grid resolution, not disagreement. km reported the unfavourable global result itself.

what_is_now_cleared.G_LEVEL: CLEARED. With B0 taken from the same report's printed PBR, per-index D2 reproduces the levels at rms 6 to 80 against index levels of roughly 3,000 to 30,000 — 0.2% to 0.3%, i.e. rounding noise.
what_is_now_cleared.handler_error_acknowledged: The v1/v2 level failure at 62.2% maximum error was an ADAPTER ARTIFACT, exactly as km suspected. The handler used the July report's 18E forward ETF P/B while the ETF grids value the underlying index. km's reclassification is accepted and the earlier level-based refutation is withdrawn as a refutation of the family.
what_is_now_cleared.discount_structure: D2, d = Rf + c, is confirmed. D1 (d = Rf + RP) is worse by 33% and D3 (d constant) by 8% on a single global parameterisation, and the multi-Rf design is what makes that comparison possible.

what_is_not_cleared.G_HORIZON: NOT CLEARED. A single global (b,c) does not fit: rms 876 with Nasdaq collapsing to 1449. Per-index (b,c) is six free parameters over 54 cells and is the per-asset fitting v1 prohibits by name.
what_is_not_cleared.the_ridge_persists: b and c trade off through b*ROE approximately equal to d, so their split is not identified by grids alone.

km_interpretation_not_supported.km_claim: per-index b tracks index retention: Dow 0.40, SPX 0.45, Nasdaq 0.58 against payouts of roughly 60/55/42 percent
km_interpretation_not_supported.handler_finding: an independent fit puts b at 0.49, 0.51, 0.46 — essentially constant across the three indices — and puts the variation in c instead, at 0.079, 0.069, 0.037
km_interpretation_not_supported.consequence: the two fits sit at different points on the same ridge. km's economic reading of b as retention is one arbitrary point, not a result. It is a named, testable hypothesis and nothing more.

next_discriminator_frozen_before_its_evi.hypothesis_under_test: b is the index's own retention ratio, a sourceable operand rather than a free parameter
next_discriminator_frozen_before_its_evi.required_evidence: index-level payout or retention for Dow, SPX and Nasdaq with a verifiable as-of at or before 2018-10-11, from the provider the report names (Bloomberg) or another independent source. NOT inferred from any grid cell, and NOT chosen from the fitted values.

gates.G_B_SOURCED: pin b per index to the SOURCED retention, not the fitted value, and re-score
gates.G_C_GLOBAL: with b so pinned, a SINGLE global c must fit all six scenario grids within the frozen 2.5% maximum-cell gate
gates.G_N_UNIQUE: exactly one N must survive on TRAIN and the unchanged HOLDOUT at that (b_sourced, c_global)

outcomes.NOT_IDENTIFIED_remains: G_B_SOURCED passes but c must still vary by index, or more than one N survives
outcomes.HYPOTHESIS_REFUTED: the sourced retention does not reproduce the grids at any single global c. Record it; do not then refit b.

explicitly_prohibited: adopting the fitted b values and calling them retention
selecting whichever of b or c to vary after seeing which fits better

verdict: YOO_METHOD_NOT_IDENTIFIED — unchanged, now resting solely on the (b,c) ridge. The book basis is resolved and the discount structure is confirmed.
